sources.facts: The national tourism authority identifies the historical shrine on the rock at Amin Abad near Ray.

Pages 170–171, fieldwork catalogue IT-3 for Rayy and Moṣṭafavi’s architectural description. About 33 by 22 m of historic enclosure below the surrounding northern rock, with deep-set masonry domes on its south side, and later dividing walls, porches and rooms.

Boyce describes successive construction phases in the historical shrine and identifies early stone construction with Safavid and Qajar extensions. The disputed burial tradition is independent of the building geometry.
